record.name: Klaviyo
record.one_liner: Klaviyo API allows developers to build personalized marketing experiences, manage customer profiles, events, and campaigns via REST endpoints using private API keys or OAuth.

auth.notes: Server-side endpoints (/api) use private API keys passed via the Authorization header (Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key) or OAuth for tech partners. Client-side endpoints (/client) use public API keys via query parameters.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for free and create test accounts to get started immediately.

api_surface.notes: Provides JSON:API compliant REST APIs and mobile/web SDKs.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve test accounts can be created for free, and the API surface is fully documented with private and public API key methods as well as provided SDKs.

evidence.claim: Get started for free and install Klaviyo maintained SDKs offered in Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node.
Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth for server-side APIs and public key authentication for client-side APIs.
Mobile SDKs are available for iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter apps.
